posts.title: Clean Architecture Template 11.0.0: .NET 10 and .NET 11 Side by Side
posts.description: .NET 11 shipped on 10 November, and version 11.0.0 of the Clean Architecture Solution Template is now available. The headline change: rather than moving the template from .NET 10 to .NET 11, it now supports both . You choose the target framework when you create a solution. Why both?
